summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K reporting the redemption and final coupon payment of a short-term financing bond (ISIN TRFTCEL62613) with a nominal amount of TRY 500 million, a 104-day maturity, and an annual simple interest rate of 40.25%. The bond was issued via private placement to qualified investors in Turkey, with the redemption occurring on June 24, 2026. This is a routine debt repayment event, not a special situation.
